summary: The first 9dc951 MCP run completed with exit 0 but exposed harness setup defects: GetWorktree arguments were ordered incorrectly; RegisterAgent and retry calls reached the authorization denial path, whose error serializer threw because DefaultHttpContext.RequestServices was null. Corrected the GetWorktree call to pass project name, actor, and full linked-worktree path; added a minimal ServiceProvider with IOptions<JarvisOptions>; attached it to each request context; and added a preflight assertion that every declared harness scope is present in the principal. Started a Release rebuild on the assigned 9dc951 source.
